dedupeText: galactic sci fi pop album cover outer space ufo lunar surface neon glow superhero aesthetic 8 bit typography lens flare cosmic subject centered against a vertical beam of light ufos positioned in the upper quadrants creating a triangular frame contrast between the cool blue space and warm orange light beam text elements placed in the mid ground interacting with the subject s silhouette combine a central heroic figure with a dual tone orange blue cosmic environment utilizing glowing neon and pixelated typography to establish a retro futuristic sci fi theme

recipe.visualDefinition: A central female figure in a metallic superhero-inspired bodysuit stands on a cratered lunar surface, flanked by hovering UFOs and a distant Earth, illuminated by a vertical beam of light and intense cosmic lens flares.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a vertical beam of light
UFOs positioned in the upper quadrants creating a triangular frame
Contrast between the cool blue space and warm orange light beam
Text elements placed in the mid-ground, interacting with the subject's silhouette
coreInvariants: Lunar surface texture in the foreground
Intense outer-glow effect on primary typography
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows and bright highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright vertical light beam behind the subject's torso.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the lunar surface, then outward to the UFOs and typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with minimal negative space, filled with stars, nebulae, and planetary elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep cosmic blue and violet for the background and space elements.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange and white for the light beam and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic red and gold on the subject's attire.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in light effects; high value contrast between the dark space and glowing elements.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, rounded geometric strokes with heavy outer glow.
Secondary text uses a monospaced, pixelated grid structure.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Rounded terminals on primary display text to mimic neon tubing.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between smooth, glowing neon-style display type and sharp, technical pixel type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, tubular geometric structure of the main display text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Arcade Classic or VCR OSD Mono
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the retro-digital/pixelated feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic sci-fi scene featuring a woman in a red and gold metallic superhero suit standing on a cratered moon surface. Behind her, a bright vertical beam of orange light shoots into space. In the dark blue sky, include two large, glowing UFO saucers and a distant blue Earth. Add intense lens flares and cosmic dust.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold, rounded geometric sans-serif title on the left side with a heavy white outer glow. Add a smaller, pixelated subtitle on the right side with a subtle glow. Ensure the main title appears slightly behind the subject's silhouette.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text glowing intensely?
Is the subject standing on a lunar surface?
Are there two distinct UFOs in the composition?
Is the color palette dominated by blue and orange contrast?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any existing brand logos or legal notices
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic integration of the subject into the environment.
Ensure the light beam aligns with the subject's center.
Verify that the typography glow doesn't obscure the text legibility.
Confirm the presence of the Earth in the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central heroic figure with a dual-tone (orange/blue) cosmic environment, utilizing glowing neon and pixelated typography to establish a retro-futuristic sci-fi theme.
